title: Report descriptions are on screen only, not in the PDF or CSV
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A/R Summary and A/P Unpaid Invoices have open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/R Summary and download its PDF and CSV from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Search both files for the words "unpaid balance".
  3. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices and download its PDF and CSV.
  4. Search both files for the words "grouped by vendor".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both download.
  • Step 2: the words are not found: the description is not in the PDF or CSV.
  • Step 3: both download.
  • Step 4: not found.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-N1: “The descriptions appear on screen only, not in the PDF or CSV.”
  • S8-R1: “Each report has the native report info icon (the one Work In Progress and Technician Utilization use) directly right of its title. Hovering, keyboard focus or a tap shows the report's description in a tooltip; moving away or Escape closes it. The descriptions:”
